title: Carbon UIShell Frame Cutover — Option A (Frame-via-renderer)
doctrine: ZERO STATIC / ZERO LEGACY / ZERO FALLBACK — DB stores, Dynamic UI declares, UI-OS resolves, frontend renders only normalized runtime

filesChanged.summary: DosShellFrameStructuralComponent — render-only diagnostic for shell.frame.* structural primitives (hidden marker span; data-frame-* attrs)
Removed 'shell.frame': null entry. Added 14 explicit shell.frame.* entries mapping to DosShellFrameStructuralComponent

DosShellSidebarNavComponent now wraps inner items in real <cds-sidenav>. Dropped raw <ul class='cds--side-nav__items'> fallback list. DosShellModuleCardsComponent rewritten to use real <cds-clickable-tile> from TilesModule (no longer goes through DosCarbonTileComponent)

Rewritten to compose <cds-tile> / <cds-clickable-tile> from real Carbon TilesModule. No more hand-rolled <a class='cds--tile'>. clickable=false renders <cds-tile>; clickable=true renders <cds-clickable-tile> with router navigation via (click)

Removed class='cds--header' from outer <header> and class='cds--content' from outer <main>. Added isShellOnlyRoute() computed (sourced from chrome.landingRoute, no hardcoded literal). Added .dos-page-container--full-bleed class binding + CSS modifier (max-inline-size:none; margin-inline:0; inline-size:100%)
Added 3 forbidden patterns: raw <header class='cds--header'>, raw <main class='cds--content'>, 'shell.frame':null COMPONENT_MAP entry

dbMigration.status: applied + recorded prior to frontend cutover
dbMigration.summary: dos.dynamic_ui_component_registry.renderer_key for the 14 workspace.frame.* rows is now per-component

lint-no-static-nav-fallback.status: PASS — SPA does not use static nav as source of truth

lint-no-legacy-uios-shell.status: PASS — 0 forbidden legacy patterns across 27 scan dirs

notes: Frame surfaces are catalog-observable but render only a hidden marker; visible Carbon UIShell DOM is painted by DosWorkspaceHeaderComponent (cds-header), DosShellSidebarNavComponent (cds-sidenav), DosShellModuleCardsComponent (cds-clickable-tile)
isShellOnlyRoute is sourced from UI-OS chrome.landingRoute (DB-driven). No /workspace-home literal added to shell/nav/bootstrap source.
DosCarbonTileComponent rewritten to compose real Carbon primitives but module cards now bypass the wrapper to use cds-clickable-tile directly (per cutover spec).
